rationale.text: The page has its title in head, but the cross-site frame it embeds shows text and has no title element. The wording asks whether each web page has a title and does not say whether a framed document is itself a web page for this test. The custom check answers cannot_tell for that reason (step 3); only the record supports this branch. This is the second half of the mixed pair: a titled document beside an untitled one is never passed. axe's document-title reports no fault on this page (it does not fault the framed document), so with a resolving link answering cannot_tell and no fault on the requirement, the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.
